---
description: "Preserve the SQL-to-EF generated model boundary when changing the database or DataLib."
applyTo: "src/XtremeIdiots.Portal.Repository.Database/**/*.sql,src/XtremeIdiots.Portal.Repository.Database/*.sqlproj,src/XtremeIdiots.Portal.Repository.Database/*.refactorlog,src/XtremeIdiots.Portal.Repository.DataLib/*.cs,src/XtremeIdiots.Portal.Repository.DataLib/*.json,src/XtremeIdiots.Portal.Repository.DataLib/*.csproj"
---

# DataLib generation boundary

`XtremeIdiots.Portal.Repository.Database` is the schema source. EF Core Power Tools generates the DataLib entities and `PortalDbContext.cs` from the built DACPAC using `efcpt-config.json`.

- Do not casually edit files marked `<auto-generated>`; regeneration overwrites them.
- Put deliberate custom behavior in clearly named hand-written partials such as `*.Partial.cs`.
- When a table participating in the model changes, update the SQL project and `efcpt-config.json` together, then regenerate DataLib in the same change.
- Preserve required post-deployment scripts and database objects that are not represented by generated entities.

From the repository root:

```pwsh
dotnet build src\XtremeIdiots.Portal.Repository.Database\XtremeIdiots.Portal.Repository.Database.sqlproj

# Install only when efcpt is not already available.
dotnet tool install --global ErikEJ.EFCorePowerTools.Cli --version 9.*

Push-Location src\XtremeIdiots.Portal.Repository.DataLib
efcpt ..\XtremeIdiots.Portal.Repository.Database\bin\Debug\XtremeIdiots.Portal.Repository.Database.dacpac mssql -i .\efcpt-config.json
Pop-Location

dotnet build src\XtremeIdiots.Portal.Repository.sln
dotnet test src\XtremeIdiots.Portal.Repository.sln --filter "FullyQualifiedName!~IntegrationTests"
```

Review regenerated changes for unexpected entity deletion, property/nullability changes, relationship changes, and edits to hand-written partials.
